title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
explanation:
# Apollo 11's Lunar Snapshot

On July 20, 1969, Neil Armstrong captured this historic image of Buzz Aldrin on the Moon's surface, where the astronaut unfurled a sheet of foil designed to catch particles streaming from the Sun—essentially creating a cosmic butterfly net to collect invisible solar material. This ingenious Solar Wind Composition Experiment, along with 22 kilograms of moon rocks and soil, was brought back to Earth, giving scientists their first direct samples of material ejected from the Sun and the lunar surface itself.
